rust_summary: a check whether an entity may take a status effect (`native_mob_effect_applicable`).
doc_summary: a check whether an entity may take a status effect, where `LivingEntity.canBeAffected` would be asked: `native_mob_effect_applicable(entity, kind, effect, amplifier, duration, result)` hears the entity's id and type, the effect, its amplifier and its duration before the effect is added. `None` keeps the entity's own answer (`DEFAULT`), `Some(true)` forces the effect on (`APPLY`), `Some(false)` keeps it off (`DO_NOT_APPLY`), and the first mod that answers decides. An `APPLY` still meets checks that are not `canBeAffected` (a wither's own `addEffect` refuses every effect). Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mob_effect_applicable@.
